title: CLI publishes to PyPI via semantic-release
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Release
  Scenario: Merge to main releases
    Given conventional commits on main
    When the release workflow runs
    Then python-semantic-release publishes auritus to PyPI via OIDC trusted publishing
    And CHANGELOG is updated
```

## Implementation brief
1. cli/pyproject.toml semantic_release config.
2. .github/workflows/release.yml on main with PyPI trusted publisher.
3. Docs model license verdict recorded.
